summary: Completed frontend-only validation on public preview for Hero V3 cinematic transition, spatial map sequence, menu determinism, and timeline controls across desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). Most requested behaviors pass; timeline keyboard year-change failed reproducibly in this run.

ui_bugs.issue: Keyboard arrows did not change year during repeated desktop checks, while next button worked (2007 -> 2008).

action_items: Fix timeline keyboard handling so ArrowRight/ArrowLeft deterministically changes year whenever timeline is in viewport.
Re-verify keyboard behavior after fix on desktop with menu-open/menu-closed states and after mouse-wheel interactions.
Keep current passing behavior unchanged: full Hero V3 first viewport, central shrink then names, spatial map sequence, and menu deterministic section jumps.
critical_code_review_comments: SeasonTimeline keydown effect has no dependency array and rebinds each render; this can cause unstable keyboard behavior and should be stabilized.
Global CSS rule in HeroV3.css (`html,body,#root,.app-shell,.hero-v3{position:relative!important}`) is high-risk and may cause future cross-section layout regressions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PASS verified on desktop+mobile: fresh load starts at top with full-width Hero V3, hero remains full in early phase, central shrink occurs before LEWIS/HAMILTON opposite-side transition, no blank frame at tested transition point, spatial map with origin+five nodes appears, Legacy node emphasized, map camera transform changes across scroll, Legacy section reachable, menu navigation deterministic to Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories, no horizontal overflow on 1920x800 and 390x844, stats settle to 105/7/104, key images load. FAIL in this run: timeline keyboard arrows did not advance years while timeline next button did.
rca of the issue: Repro steps: navigate to Timeline (menu or direct scroll), confirm active year 2007, click next button -> year becomes 2008, then press ArrowRight/ArrowLeft -> year remains 2008. Wheel scroll correctly does not change year. Probable root cause: unstable keydown listener lifecycle/focus gating in SeasonTimeline (`useEffect` without dependency array and viewport-bound checks) causing keyboard events not consistently applying state updates. Mitigation: stabilize listener with dependency array + functional state updates and re-test keyboard path in viewport-focused timeline state.
